title: Review Access Keys
description: Check the active access keys for the customer-api principal to determine their usage patterns.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm if the access keys are being misused or if they need to be revoked.

title: Identify Cost Impact
description: Examine the cost impact of the suspicious activity to understand its financial implications.
recommended_next_focus: Assess the financial impact of the suspicious activity.

title: Investigate Cloud Trail Logs
description: Review CloudTrail logs for the customer-api principal to find any unusual activities.
recommended_next_focus: Identify if there are any unauthorized CloudTrail log entries or anomalies.
